package records

import (
	"context"
	xpredicate "github.com/viant/xdatly/predicate"
)

// Threshold consumes the actual generated invocation input through scoped DI.
type Threshold struct {
	Input *RecordsInput `bind:"kind=input,required"`
}

func (p *Threshold) Compute(_ context.Context, _ any) (*xpredicate.Criteria, error) {
	return &xpredicate.Criteria{Expression: "id >= ?", Placeholders: []any{p.Input.Minimum}}, nil
}
